hero.title: Master Networks. Build Your Expertise.
hero.subtitle: NetOps Academy is your learning platform for network infrastructure, professional technologies, and essential Network Engineering skills.

presentation.title: Everything you need to master network engineering
presentation.subtitle: A unified platform bringing together theoretical depth, practical hands-on mastery, and active recall in one cohesive environment.

theory.title: Theoretical Foundations
theory.desc: Fundamental RFC standards, enterprise routing protocols, and multi-vendor network architectures explained clearly.

memory.title: Active Spaced Recall
memory.desc: Leitner 5-box SRS algorithm calculating optimal review intervals to lock knowledge into long-term retention.

evaluation.title: Rigorous Evaluation
evaluation.desc: Timed proctored exam simulator based on the standard 825/1000 passing scale with granular answer breakdowns.

practice.title: Hands-on Practice
practice.desc: Full Cisco IOS-XE simulated terminal alongside guided labs for VLANs, 802.1Q trunks, and dynamic routing.

exploration.title: Multi-Cloud Exploration
exploration.desc: Comparative multi-cloud encyclopedia (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, GCP Interconnect) with network topology diagrams.

progress.title: Continuous Mastery
progress.desc: Real-time domain radar, accuracy score analytics, and pinpointed identification of areas needing review.

features.heading: Core Platform Features
features.subheading: Six technological pillars engineered to accelerate your command of enterprise networking.

noc.title: NOC Cockpit & Telemetry
noc.desc: Real-time command dashboard featuring global readiness metrics, daily streak tracking, and cognitive endurance indicators.

flashcards.title: Smart Spaced Flashcards (SRS)
flashcards.desc: Leitner 5-box spaced repetition engine with 3D card flips, domain filters, and integrated audio TTS reader.

exams.title: Proctored Mock Exams
exams.desc: Official timed simulator with international 825/1000 benchmark scoring, multiple-choice drills, scratchpad, and CIDR calculator.

labs.title: Hands-on Network Labs
labs.desc: Practical engineering scenarios: 802.1Q trunking, EtherChannel link bundling, security Access Control Lists (ACLs), and OSPF.

terminal.title: Simulated Cisco IOS-XE Terminal
terminal.desc: Interactive training environment faithfully replicating Cisco command modes (User EXEC, Privileged, Config), TAB completion, and history.

encyclopedia.title: Cloud & Technical Encyclopedia
encyclopedia.desc: Comparative multi-cloud knowledge base, hybrid network topologies, connectivity schematics, and enterprise peering matrices.

learning.heading: A Complete Pedagogical Journey
learning.subheading: A structured four-stage methodology turning complex networking concepts into instinctual engineering skills.

step1.name: Learn
step1.title: Grasp the Foundations
step1.desc: Absorb protocol architectures, open RFC standards, and official certification blueprints from leading vendors.

step2.name: Practice
step2.title: Manipulate Through Practice
step2.desc: Apply theoretical knowledge via targeted flashcard drills, guided lab challenges, and simulated CLI commands.

step3.name: Evaluate
step3.title: Benchmark Knowledge
step3.desc: Test yourself under real timed exam conditions with strict score tracking and in-depth question rationales.

step4.name: Improve
step4.title: Reinforce & Advance
step4.desc: Pinpoint technical blind spots through radar analytics and schedule optimized review cycles using the SRS algorithm.

technologies.heading: Technologies & Covered Domains
technologies.subheading: Real-world engineering protocols and concepts actively represented across our curriculum.

bilingual.heading: Learn in Your Language
bilingual.subheading: An experience designed for English and French speaking engineers alike.
bilingual.desc: NetOps Academy offers an accessible experience in French and English, with instantaneous in-place language switching preserving active workflows.
bilingual.detail: The entire user interface, navigation, NOC cockpit, timed exam simulator (102 exam questions), and interactive workshops are 100% bilingual. The foundational corpus of 2,900 flashcards is authored in French, embedding standard English RFC terms and CLI syntax directly.

devices.heading: Multi-Device & Offline Experience
devices.subheading: Study anywhere, from the enterprise NOC console to your mobile phone on the go.

desktop.title: Workstation Desktop
desktop.desc: Expansive multi-pane layout featuring full-screen terminal, keyboard quick search (Ctrl+K), and floating CIDR calculator.

tablet.title: Tablet Experience
tablet.desc: Touch-optimized fluid interface ideal for 3D flashcard flipping and zooming into hybrid network topologies.

mobile.title: Smartphone & PWA
mobile.desc: Ergonomic thumb-friendly navigation bar, quick drawer menu, and mobile Blitz review sessions.

devices.pwaDesc: Install NetOps Academy directly to your desktop or mobile home screen in one click. Our Service Worker keeps your drills accessible even during network outages.

audiences.heading: Who is NetOps Academy for?
audiences.subheading: Engineered for network professionals and learners at every milestone of their journey.

students.title: Network & Telecom Students
students.desc: Turn university or engineering curriculum theory into immediate practical hands-on capability.

technicians.title: Support Technicians & Admins
technicians.desc: Upgrade vendor CLI configuration skills and accelerate day-to-day network incident troubleshooting.

engineers.title: Network Engineers & NOC Operators
engineers.desc: Maintain top-tier engineering sharpness and test reflexes against realistic complex network scenarios.

candidates.title: Certification Candidates
candidates.desc: Prepare rigorously for industry exams (Cisco CCNA, CCNP ENCOR/ENARSI, Palo Alto PCNSE, CompTIA Network+).
